description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/55042)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, cadastral maps, and the legal process for claiming property interests under the Registration of Title Act. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land ownership, title registration, and property transfers.
